blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · This sardine pasta is weeknight cookin…
blocks_element.text: This sardine pasta is weeknight cooking at its finest: one pan, thirty minutes, and a pantry-friendly ingredient list that packs a serious punch. Bright lemon zest, savory garlic, a touch of colatura, and the silky olive oil straight from the tin come together for a rich, balanced sauce. If you’ve been on the fence about sardines, this is the recipe to convert you—quality tinned sardines are meaty, clean-flavored, and deeply savory without being overpowering. Fishwife sardines hold their texture beautifully in a warm pasta dish, so reserve your pasta water, toast those pine nuts, and whatever you do, don’t throw away that sardine oil!
